articles.title: Hidalgo County Confirms First New World Screwworm Case; Quarantine Imposed on Four-County Area
No Yellow Fever certificate? Kenyan travelers to India now face a 6-day quarantine
articles.description: Travelers arriving in India from Kenya must carry an original, valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. Those without acceptable proof may face quarantine of up to six days under India's health advisory.

articles.title: Centre proposes mandatory six-day quarantine for unvaccinated passengers from yellow fever-risk countries
articles.description: A list of 29 African countries and 13 countries in Central and South America figure among countries at risk for yellow fever. Uganda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Burundi, Kenya, Venezuela are among the countries cited.

articles.title: India drafts new health rules that could impose six‑day quarantine on Kenyan travellers
articles.description: India’s draft Aircraft (Public Health) Rules would require Kenyan visitors without a yellow‑fever certificate to undergo up to six days of quarantine or be denied entry.
